items.title: Nvidia's Q2 earnings to test resurgent AI trade
items.summary: Nvidia will report its Q2 earnings after the bell on Aug. 26.

items.title: TSLA Stock Races Past NVDA, GOOG In August Rally: Elon Musk’s TeraFab And Semi Bets Shift Into High Gear
items.summary: Tesla will open its Nevada Semi factory on Sept.24, with capacity to produce as many as 50,000 trucks annually.

items.title: The AI accountability problem is getting bigger
items.summary: Companies and regulators are struggling to determine who is responsible when things go wrong.

items.title: Alphabet Spends About 60 Cents of Every Technical Infrastructure Dollar on Servers. Nvidia's Biggest Customers Were Just Told Prices Are Going Up More Than 15%.
items.summary: Part of the search giant's biggest spending line may have just repriced -- and the year the increase lands on doesn't have a budget number yet.

items.title: How Google and Marvell’s Partnership Changes Everything
items.summary: Marvell recently issued Google a warrant for up to 58.97 million shares at an exercise price of $206.58 per share. Eric Bleeker and Austin Smith break down the partnership between the two companies, as well as what it could mean to the AI landscape as a whole.

items.title: Meta, States Have Discussed Settling Teen Social Media Case
items.summary: Meta Platforms Inc. and state attorneys general have discussed a possible mid-trial settlement of a blockbuster case accusing the company of deliberately designing Facebook and Instagram to addict teens, people familiar with the matter said.

items.title: Robotics startup Generalist reaches $3B valuation, sources say
items.summary: The $200 million extension comes just months after the physical AI startup reached a $2 billion valuation.

items.title: Zoom Reports Solid Earnings. The Stock Drops Anyway.
items.summary: Zoom reported adjusted earnings of $1.55 a share for the quarter, up from $1.53 a year ago and above analysts’ expectations for $1.48, per FactSet.
